definitions.explanation: A person who enters a place without permission or authorization. Can refer to burglars, unauthorized visitors, or in a broader sense, foreign invaders.

examples.japanese: {侵入者|しんにゅうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{捕|つか}まった→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
⟦セキュリティ→セキュリティ：04867_sekyuriti⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{侵入者|しんにゅうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映|うつ}っていた→映る：12964_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: An intruder was captured on the security camera.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{侵入者|しんにゅうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An intruder came into the yard in the middle of the night, so I immediately called the police.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧ (intrusion, trespassing) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). The word carries a clear negative connotation — the person is somewhere they should not be.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {侵入者|しんにゅうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧ — to catch an intruder
- {侵入者|しんにゅうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検知|けんち}→検知：18762_kenchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to detect an intruder
- ⟦{不法|ふほう}→不法：11361_fuhou⟧{侵入者|しんにゅうしゃ} — illegal trespasser

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧ — intrusion, trespassing (the act itself)
- ⟦{不審者|ふしんしゃ}→不審者：11348_fushinsha⟧ — suspicious person; broader term, not necessarily someone who has already entered
- ⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧ — thief, burglar; implies intent to steal
